packages.name: International Esports Mega-Events
packages.description: Premium intl tournaments (groups, knockouts, playoffs): top-tier venues, intl player/crew travel & hotels, full live broadcast & security. Range: PHP 10M–20M+. Venue rental billed separately (venue rate + ASF + VAT).

packages.name: Caravan & Mobile Truck Activations
packages.description: Touring activations across cities: outsourced full-service execution, truck skinning/wrapping, graphic design, community management, local/regional talent. Range: PHP 3.5M–5M.

packages.name: Large-Scale Stage & Booth Fabrications
packages.description: High-end set construction for leagues/mega events: main-stage fabrication, board-ups, custom player/caster tables, heavy technical bundles (LED, truss, gensets), CGI/VFX. Range: PHP 1M–5M+.

packages.name: Major Pro Leagues & Regional Tournaments
packages.description: Multi-week seasons: regular + playoff broadcast, large technical packages (LED walls, lights, sounds), security, league-ops manpower, talent hospitality. Range: PHP 3.5M–8M+. Venue rental billed separately.

packages.name: Creator & Influencer Tournaments
packages.description: Creator-driven exhibition tournaments: influencer talent management, main-stage & photo-area fabrication, basic broadcast, digital/community pushes. Range: PHP 1M–2M.

packages.name: Immersive Mall Activations & Experiential Booths
packages.description: Interactive mall installations & custom booths: stage/booth beautification, interactive tech/gaming setups, LED/audio, custom fabrication. Range: PHP 800K–1.5M. Mall/venue space billed separately.

packages.name: Public Game Test Launches
packages.description: Public launch/live-test: premium theater/venue, dedicated high-speed internet, broadcast equipment, specialized crew (e.g. interpreters). Range: PHP 1.5M–2.5M. Venue rental billed separately.

packages.name: PR, Social & KOL Campaigns
packages.description: Integrated digital marketing: PR advertorials, social content, KOL sourcing, media buying & gaming-site banners (KOL fees vary by reach). Range: PHP 150K–600K+ per campaign.

packages.name: 3D Billboard — V1: 1 Output (10–15s)
packages.description: 3D anamorphic Digital Moving OOH, one (1) 10–15s output (published a-la-carte rate). Includes concept & storyboarding, 3D anamorphic grid, styleframes, 3D asset creation & rigging, animation & VFX, rendering & post, SSD storage, file turnover, PM & OOP fees. ~5–7 weeks, max 3 revisions/phase. Inclusive of Agency Service Fee. (Solaire proposal; rates eff. until Dec 2026.)

packages.name: Corporate & Sponsored Tournaments
packages.description: Medium-scale sponsor-backed: control room + broadcast technical bundles, referees/league ops, event coordination & PM. Range: PHP 500K–1M. Venue rental billed separately.

packages.name: 3D Billboard — V2: 2 Outputs (1+1 bundle, 25% off)
packages.description: Two (2) 10–15s Digital Moving OOH at ₱600,000 each (25% bundle savings). Same inclusions as V1. Inclusive of Agency Service Fee.

packages.name: Watch Parties & Fan Zones
packages.description: Community watch events: studio/venue, stage setup, on-ground coordination, F&B, fan giveaways. Range: PHP 300K–800K. Venue rental billed separately.

packages.name: 3D Billboard — V3: 10 Outputs (bulk, 50% off)
packages.description: Ten (10) 10–15s Digital Moving OOH at ₱400,000 each (50% bulk savings). Same inclusions as V1. Inclusive of Agency Service Fee.

packages.name: Internal Corporate Socials & Networking
packages.description: Private gatherings/alumni nights: customized buffet, venue, corporate merch, raffle prizes. Range: PHP 300K–500K. Venue rental billed separately.

packages.name: Projection Mapping
packages.description: Project-based; scales with scale/equipment/content. Small (pop-ups, retail windows) ~₱290K; Mid (galleries, immersive rooms) ~₱1.45M; Large public/architectural ₱8.7M–₱58M+. Starts-at shown.

packages.name: Closed Game Testing Events
packages.description: Small private game-mechanics testing: internet-cafe/PC rentals, F&B for testers, minor coordination. Range: PHP 100K–200K.

packages.name: AR/VR Experience Build
packages.description: AR/VR design & build; scales with complexity. Simple mobile AR ~₱290K; complex VR training platform ₱29M+. Starts-at shown.

packages.name: Immersive Installation Design & Deployment
packages.description: End-to-end immersive installation (hardware + software + space). Per sq ft: basic projection room ₱1,160–4,640; interactive floor/wall ₱2,900–11,600; 360° room ₱8,700–34,800; museum-grade ₱17,400–69,600+. Full-scale typical ₱2.3M–₱14.5M+. Starts-at shown.

packages.name: Interactive Game Development (Experiential Activation)
packages.description: Custom mobile/interactive game for experiential activations. Basic/casual 2D (offline, static UI) ₱150K–₱400K; mid-level interactive (3D, basic multiplayer, leaderboards, IAP) ₱400K–₱1.5M. Cost drivers: art/assets (3D > 2D), backend (leaderboards, cloud save, matchmaking), ongoing server OPEX. Starts-at shown.
